test1_sign_symmetry.description: W -> W^T (global) and local-edge-reversal (just the cycle's 6 edges) both tested. RESULT: INCONCLUSIVE, not failed -- both reversals kill sustained oscillation on this node set entirely (winding=0, all_settled=False) rather than flipping to +1. Diagnosed: eigenvalues of W and W^T are IDENTICAL (general linear algebra fact), so growth rate/rotation magnitude is unaffected by transpose -- only the EIGENVECTORS (spatial localization) differ, so there is no guarantee the same 6 nodes remain the locus of instability under reversal.

test2_perturbation_robustness.description: 6 independent random initial conditions (disclosed seeds 100-105, chosen in advance) x 2 coupling forms = 12 trials, plus 2 damage-recovery-style amplitude perturbations (1 per form). RESULT: 14/14 give winding=-1 with smooth gate PASS, essentially identical max_adjacent_step (~1.487-1.496) -- strongly inconsistent with a one-off chance artifact.

test3_cycle_shift.description: 223 nearby simple cycles (sharing >=4 of the 6 original nodes) found via manual DFS in the local neighborhood (19 nodes), winding evaluated on ALL of them using the SAME phase snapshot (no new simulation per cycle). RESULT: MIXED. 3/223 pass the smoothness gate for BOTH forms -- 1 is the exact same physical loop traversed in reverse order (a trivial algebraic sign flip, winding=+1, not new evidence), 2 are 'detour' deformations (rerouting one edge through 3 extra well-connected nodes) that ALSO give winding=+1, consistent with the reversed loop -- genuine evidence winding survives smooth boundary deformation through the coherent region. The ONE direct 'swap node 9 for node 13' same-length alternative (the only such candidate the actual graph structure offers) FAILS the smoothness gate (winding=0, max_step=2.27) -- diagnosed: node 13 has degree 2 (peripheral) and a phase (~-3.12 rad) nearly pi away from node 9's (~-0.12 rad) -- consistent with node 13 lying outside the coherent cluster's spatial extent, not with pure randomness.
